Clock times: Temporal's PlainTime

Source: R/plain-time.R
plain_time.Rd

A plain_time() is a time of day with nanosecond precision and no date or time zone, stored as a double count of nanoseconds since midnight (design 4.1). The constructor is Temporal.PlainTime and Temporal.PlainTime.from() in one: it reads fields, strings or another zutempo value.

Usage

plain_time(
  hour = 0,
  minute = 0,
  second = 0,
  millisecond = 0,
  microsecond = 0,
  nanosecond = 0,
  ...,
  overflow = "constrain"
)

plain_time_compare(x, y)

Arguments

hour

The hour (0 to 23), or a string in ISO 8601 form ("12:30", "12:30:45.123456789", "T12", or a date-time whose date is ignored; a bare time that could also read as a month-day or year-month must carry the T prefix), or a plain_time() or plain_date_time() to convert.

minute, second, millisecond, microsecond, nanosecond

The remaining fields, 0 by default.

...

Must be empty.

overflow

"constrain" (the default) clamps each field to its range, "reject" raises a zutempo_range_error (design 6.2).

x, y

plain_time() values or strings, for plain_time_compare().

Value

A plain_time() vector; plain_time_compare() returns an integer vector of -1, 0 and 1.

Members

Every member of Temporal.PlainTime in the pinned specification (inst/spec/PINS) and the R function that implements it:

TemporalR
new Temporal.PlainTime()plain_time()
Temporal.PlainTime.from()plain_time()
Temporal.PlainTime.compare()plain_time_compare()
.hourhour()
.minuteminute()
.secondsecond()
.millisecondmillisecond()
.microsecondmicrosecond()
.nanosecondnanosecond()
.add()temporal_add()
.subtract()temporal_subtract()
.with()temporal_with()
.until()temporal_until()
.since()temporal_since()
.round()temporal_round()
.equals()temporal_equals()
.toString()temporal_to_string()
.toLocaleString()none: ECMA-402 (locale formatting) is out of scope
.toJSON()none: format() covers it
.valueOf()none: throws in JavaScript; no R counterpart

Examples

plain_time("12:30:45.5")
#> <zutempo_plain_time[1]>
#> [1] 12:30:45.5
plain_time(12, 30)
#> <zutempo_plain_time[1]>
#> [1] 12:30:00
plain_time(25, overflow = "constrain")
#> <zutempo_plain_time[1]>
#> [1] 23:00:00
plain_time()
#> <zutempo_plain_time[1]>
#> [1] 00:00:00
plain_time_compare("12:30", "12:31")
#> [1] -1
